provenance.weather: ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF/Copernicus) via Open-Meteo archive API, hourly, grid point -70.75, 11.75
provenance.load: headcount, envelope heat loss, snow-melt water and a 24/7 science load
provenance.load_variation: domestic demand varies +/-8% and summer workshop use 40-100% of peak, hour to hour, from a fixed pseudo-random sequence (seed 26061+year) - part of the model, not measured
provenance.generation: pvlib plane-of-array PV at 70 deg tilt; manufacturer power curve with air-density correction
